verdict.rationale: Bland documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents work with a Bland account through natural language. Agents can place and inspect calls, send texts, build and validate pathways, manage agents, query analytics, run evals and search the docs, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and documented setup/authentication details for connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
